_comment: Personas de référence (P4) au format answers.json. Servent à calibrer les scores (p5/p95 sur les candidats retrouvés) et aux démonstrations du notebook 04. P6 peut en ajouter.

free_text.ideal_book: I enjoy psychological novels exploring identity and moral dilemmas, with complex characters who hide dark secrets.
free_text.loved_book: I loved The Secret History because of the dark academic atmosphere and the group of students drawn into a crime.
free_text.atmosphere: Something melancholic, rainy, set in an old university

free_text.ideal_book: An exciting fantasy adventure for teenagers with magic, dragons and a hero who discovers hidden powers.
free_text.loved_book: I loved books where a group of friends goes on a quest in a magical world and has to save their kingdom.
free_text.atmosphere: A whimsical, magical world full of wonder, castles and enchanted forests

free_text.ideal_book: A dark, gripping crime thriller where a detective hunts a serial killer in a cold, isolated town.
free_text.loved_book: I loved The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo for its twisted investigation and its damaged, brilliant heroine.
free_text.atmosphere: Bleak, snowy, tense and unsettling, with long winter nights

free_text.ideal_book: A thoughtful non-fiction book about the meaning of life, how to live well and what makes us human.
free_text.loved_book: I loved Meditations by Marcus Aurelius because it gives practical wisdom about facing hardship calmly.
free_text.avoid: No self-help clichés or business advice

free_text.ideal_book: A sweeping love story set in the past, with a strong heroine fighting against the rules of her time.
free_text.loved_book: I loved Pride and Prejudice for the witty dialogue and the slow-burning romance between Elizabeth and Darcy.
free_text.atmosphere: Elegant ballrooms and country estates in nineteenth-century England

free_text.ideal_book: A science fiction novel about a totalitarian future society where technology controls people's lives.
free_text.loved_book: I loved 1984 because it made me think about surveillance, propaganda and freedom.
free_text.atmosphere: Oppressive, futuristic and grey, a world after collapse

free_text.ideal_book: A warm, funny and uplifting story about an unlikely group of people who become a family.
free_text.loved_book: I loved A Man Called Ove because it made me laugh and cry, and the grumpy hero slowly opens his heart.
free_text.atmosphere: Cozy, heartwarming, a small town where everyone knows each other

free_text.ideal_book: A true, inspiring life story of someone who overcame poverty, illness or war against all odds.
free_text.loved_book: I loved Educated by Tara Westover, about a girl from a survivalist family who teaches herself and goes to university.
